Use a small ALWAYS VISIBLE native Android location button, obtain real location through Android LocationManager only after tap and permission, then center Leaflet and fill the existing geographic input. Correct OpenStreetMap attribution location to bottom-right (tiny). No new permissions, tracking or backend changes; preserve existing KMZ, single WebGIS loading, animations, version gate and original signing.

Final production release rebuild after trusted-domain matcher correction.
